tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List viem-backed chain aliases and ids. Use filters to find testnets, default-RPC chains, or a named chain before resolving contracts.

tools.name: runtime_metrics
tools.description: Read process-local resolver/rung/RPC counters for smoke checks and reliability dashboards.

tools.name: lookup_selector
tools.description: Lookup gulltoppr-proven signatures for a 4-byte function/error selector or 32-byte event topic0. Prefer these over public 4byte guesses.

tools.name: registry_stats
tools.description: Read selector commons counts by proof grade and bytecode-match index size.

tools.name: export_registry
tools.description: Return the CC0 selector commons as NDJSON. This can be large; prefer lookup_selector for normal agent workflows.

tools.name: resolve_abi
tools.description: Resolve a contract's interface from chain + address via a fallback ladder (Etherscan → Sourcify → proxy → heimdall decompile → 4byte). Returns a compact capability manifest (read vs write functions, the 'buttons'), proxy chain, token metadata, and PROVENANCE. ALWAYS read `provenance`: a `decompiled`

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Call a view/pure function and get the decoded result. No wallet, no cost. Rejects state-mutating functions.

tools.name: encode_call
tools.description: Encode a function call to calldata (0x…) without sending anything.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Simulate a call and return success, gas, decoded return, and best-effort state diff / asset changes / logs. Provide a high-level call (address + function + args) or raw (to + data), never both.

tools.name: prepare_tx
tools.description: Prepare a contract WRITE for the user to sign. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction, its simulation, a human-readable summary, safety metadata, warnings, a configured signing deeplink, and an EIP-1193 wallet request when signing is recommended. tools.name: decode_tx
tools.description: Decode what a transaction did: delegated heimdall decode plus `decoded_call` from the resolved target ABI when available. Prefer `decoded_call` for typed function/arg names, and read its provenance.

tools.name: resolve_name
tools.description: Resolve an ENS/Basename to an address, or an address to its primary ENS/Basename. Pass chain=base for Basenames.
